question: Which kept flush observations distinguish never-cleared dirty qwords, and under which guards is bit 0x80000 locally idempotent?

scope.invocationPolicy: Six draw entries and commit 0x826A2FF0 consume their descendant invocations. Clear, Resolve, capture, tiling and shared helpers reached elsewhere survive. Later Original draws are a separately stated policy.
scope.qualification: Classification of direct and API readers, with limited coverage, and symbolic counterexamples that hold only under stated conditions. No observed runtime state or rendered-image difference is claimed.

readerInventory.counts: 319 direct non-SP ld candidates comprise 277 G reads, 9 non-G fields and 33 unresolved aliases. Nine accepted inline functions add 24 consumed G reads. The 277 surviving G reads contain 210 OR transfers, 2 ANDC transfers and 65 kept flush reads.

flushFamilies.role: capture only when its condition holds

readerInventory.masks: Each family has 9 G+0x10 reads, 2 G+0x18 reads and 2 G+0x20 reads. ACC60 consumes G10 bits 0..16 and 21..57, G18 mask 0x007FFFFC00000000 and G20 mask 0x0000003FFFFFFFFF. G10&G28 controls whether AC8C8 is entered, and its semantic selections include bit 8 and the G28-intersected bits 37 and 57. Emitted groups are cleared.

retainedCounterexamples.guards: At a kept flush check compare dirty0 with one extra bit, keep all other fields equal, G28=0,G30=C,C+4<G34, and valid nonwrapping nonaliased ring and shadow addresses. Preexisting [C+4]=0 distinguishes the new header. These are symbolic states, not runtime observations.
retainedCounterexamples.fastPath: ACC60 stwu at 0x826ACCF4 and 0x826ACD04 and the cursor store at 0x826ACD14 establish ring and cursor divergence without an allocator or callback on this selected branch. The emitted dirty group then converges after clear.
retainedCounterexamples.slowPath: Insufficient space calls AC610 at 0x826ACCC8. Remaining payload calls C588 at 0x826AC6B0, reloads the cursor and retries. Downstream allocation, wait and failure termination remains qualified.
retainedCounterexamples.tileRecordJoin: C588's G+0x33B0!=0 arm reaches C400. With byte 2ABD mask 0x20 clear, byte 2ABC mask 0x80 clear, nonzero command length and enough list capacity, C400 at 0x8269C4A0..0x8269C4F8 writes two words through L+8, where L=G+0x3438: 0x81000000|((C+4-S)>>2) and translated S, G+0x3A50. A cursor delta of 8 becomes a kept record-length delta of 2. List growth C170 and wrap C270 remain separate helper contracts.

bit80000.guardedResult: For deltaG10=0x80000 and G28&0x80000=0, the kept AC8C8 invocation and all ACC60 masks are unchanged. An already entered AC8C8 has no semantic test of this bit. Inspected non-dirty effects, helper and callback paths and cursors are equal; extra 0x80000 remains set.
bit80000.writerBoundary: Known G28 writers 0x8268EE50 and 0x8269CE90 toggle 0x100. 0x8269D7D8 adds bits 37 and 57, and 0x8269DB20 clears them. They preserve the zero guard if it is initially true. Constructors, copied, indexed and bulk forms, and arbitrary aliases are not accounted for.
bit80000.unconstrainedResult: If G28&0x80000!=0, extra 0x80000 can newly enter AC8C8. With G30<=G38 and no special bits it emits nothing and preserves cursor. With G30>G38 it calls C588 at 0x826AC8F0 before semantic tests. Unconditional idempotence is false.
bit80000.laterOriginal: A later Original ADD88 can now enter shader work. A compatible ADC48 hit refreshes G2E38/40. A selected small emission with byte 2ABC mask 0x40 clear appends three words headed 0xC0012700, advances G30 by 12 and stamps Rv+0x40. A reusable miss can patch persistent C, update the cache and allocate an ID. A busy or forced inline path can allocate, copy and patch ring storage. These differ from a baseline that skips the check.

aliasBoundary.scanQualification: Whole-image raw field scan selected 21,598 candidates; generated scan selected 14,835 of 3,436,498 instruction comments with matched base and displacement encoding checks. High-field overlaps were global; low 0..0x70 only in [0x82680000,0x826D0000). Syntax counts are not G provenance or a complete list of readers.

nextDiscriminator: Resolve the 33 explicit aliases, the partial, indexed, bulk and copy forms, and the ACFF8 literal-pointer dispatch before claiming universal G0 and G8 omission or low32-G18 omission.
Establish the initial G28 bit 0x80000 guard and all writers before using its kept-flush projection.
Replace or preserve cursor, list-record, allocator and lifetime observations before discarding whole dirty-qword clears; model later Original entry points separately.
guards: Do not call all surviving dirty readers OR-only, or call whole G10/G18/G20 never-clear idempotent merely because GPU register payload is redundant.
Do not equate a symbolic ring or list difference with an observed rendered or API-return difference.
Do not extend a fixed consumed-draw projection to later Original draws or unresolved indirect constant-flush entry points.
conclusion: Whole G10, G18 and G20 sticky policies have kept ring and cursor counterexamples and a tile-record observation that holds only under a condition. Bit 0x80000 is locally idempotent only under a stated G28 and invocation guard. G0, G8 and low32-G18 have projection results of limited scope, with aliases and later Originals open.
